dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: I don't know many places as quiet as this. It's so peaceful here, *yawn* I'm starting to get sleepy...

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: But if I fall asleep now, I'll only mess up my circadian rhythm...

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Maybe I should find something to read. Any recommendations?
